capabilities: Copy a Markdown link to a marked table row
Open a row link at the marked row in Source mode
Jump to marked rows within the current note
Search the vault for marked rows (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a table editor; it only inserts anchor comments into rows and resolves links to them.
extras: Freemium: copy and jump are free; vault search, reading-view links and anchor cleanup need a GitHub Sponsors payment ($5/month or $15 once). The What's new tab promotes other NoteMods plugins and links to notemods.com. Desktop on macOS tested; mobile, Windows, Linux and external URI launch untested.
problem: Obsidian links cannot target a specific data row inside a Markdown table, so precise references to one row are hard to share.

relations.evidence: Pro features need a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike

summary: Row-link plugin that anchors a Markdown table row with a comment and copies an obsidian:// link that opens the note at that row.
